product_overview: A personal developer portfolio website to present the developer's introduction, skills, projects, and a public contact form. (Source: Product Specification Document, pages 1-2.)
core_goals: Showcase the developer's name, introduction, skills, technologies, and projects to recruiters, clients, and peers.
Provide a public contact form that validates input and allows visitors to send messages.
Provide an authenticated admin area to manage skills, skill categories, projects, experience entries, and site settings.

features.name: Public Home / Portfolio Viewing
features.description: Public landing page that displays the developer's name/introduction, skills, project cards with links, and the contact form (see Product Specification Document, page 1).
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See developer name and introduction -> Scroll to Skills section -> See list of skills and icons -> Scroll to Projects section -> Click a project card -> See project detail or external link
Navigate to / -> Observe contact form visible with required fields (Name, Email, Message) -> Click Send Message button without filling fields -> See validation errors for required fields
Navigate to / -> Experience a network or asset load failure -> See a user-facing error or fallback content on the page

features.name: Contact Form (Public)
features.description: Public contact form on / for visitors to send messages. Validates required fields and email format and displays success or error messages (see Product Specification Document, page 2).
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill name -> Fill email -> Fill message -> Click Send Message button -> See success message
Navigate to / -> Click Send Message button -> See validation error for required name
Navigate to / -> Fill name -> Fill email (invalid format) -> Fill message -> Click Send Message button -> See invalid email format error message
Navigate to / -> Fill name -> Fill email -> Fill message -> Click Send Message button -> See server error message if submission fails

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Secure admin sign-in page for administrators to authenticate before accessing admin routes. Uses inputs for email and password (code: src/app/admin/login/page.tsx).
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/login -> Fill email input -> Fill password input -> Click Sign In button -> Be redirected to /admin/categories
Navigate to /admin/login -> Fill email input -> Fill password input (incorrect) -> Click Sign In button -> See authentication error message
Navigate to /admin/login -> Leave email or password empty -> Click Sign In button -> See validation error messages

features.name: Skill Categories Management
features.description: Authenticated admin interface at /admin/categories to create, edit, and delete skill categories. Fields include category name, icon name and description (code: src/app/admin/categories/page.tsx).
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/categories -> Click Add Category button -> Fill category name -> Fill icon name -> Fill description -> Click submit button -> See new category in list
Navigate to /admin/categories -> Click Add Category button -> Fill icon name -> Fill description -> Click submit button -> See validation error for required category name
Navigate to /admin/categories -> Click Edit on an existing category -> Fill category name -> Click submit button -> See updated category in list
Navigate to /admin/categories -> Click Delete on a category -> Confirm deletion -> See category removed from list
Navigate to /admin/categories -> Click Delete on a category -> Confirm deletion -> See deletion error message if server rejects request

features.name: Skills Management
features.description: Authenticated admin interface at /admin/skills to create, update and delete individual skills and assign them to categories (route: /admin/skills).
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/skills -> Click Add Skill button -> Fill skill name -> Select category -> Fill optional details -> Click submit button -> See new skill in list
Navigate to /admin/skills -> Click Add Skill button -> Leave skill name empty -> Click submit button -> See validation error for required skill name
Navigate to /admin/skills -> Click Edit on a skill -> Change fields -> Click submit button -> See updated skill in list
Navigate to /admin/skills -> Click Delete on a skill -> Confirm deletion -> See skill removed from list
Navigate to /admin/skills -> Click Delete on a skill -> Confirm deletion -> See deletion error message on failure

features.name: Projects Management
features.description: Authenticated admin interface at /admin/projects to add and manage project entries, descriptions, links and technology tags (route: /admin/projects).
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/projects -> Click Add Project button -> Fill project title -> Fill description -> Fill link or repository URL -> Add technology tags -> Click submit button -> See new project in list
Navigate to /admin/projects -> Click Add Project button -> Leave title empty -> Click submit button -> See validation error for required title
Navigate to /admin/projects -> Click Edit on a project -> Update fields -> Click submit button -> See updated project in list
Navigate to /admin/projects -> Click Delete on a project -> Confirm deletion -> See project removed from list
Navigate to /admin/projects -> Click Delete on a project -> Confirm deletion -> See deletion error message on failure

features.name: Experience Management
features.description: Authenticated admin interface at /admin/experience to create and maintain experience or work history entries (route: /admin/experience).
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/experience -> Click Add Experience button -> Fill company name -> Fill role/title -> Fill dates -> Fill description -> Click submit button -> See new experience item in list
Navigate to /admin/experience -> Click Add Experience button -> Leave role/title empty -> Click submit button -> See validation error for required fields
Navigate to /admin/experience -> Click Edit on an experience entry -> Modify fields -> Click submit button -> See updated entry in list
Navigate to /admin/experience -> Click Delete on an entry -> Confirm deletion -> See entry removed from list
Navigate to /admin/experience -> Click Delete on an entry -> Confirm deletion -> See deletion error message on failure

features.name: Settings Management
features.description: Authenticated admin interface at /admin/settings for updating general site settings such as site title, social links and other metadata (route: /admin/settings).
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/settings -> Update site title field -> Update social link fields -> Click Save or submit button -> See success message and updated settings applied
Navigate to /admin/settings -> Leave a required field blank -> Click Save or submit button -> See validation error message
Navigate to /admin/settings -> Update fields -> Click Save or submit button -> See server error message if save fails
